limits: Four selected public-task cells, one model, not a held-out/general quality or release result.

budget_evidence.scope_note: Bounded prefix of normalized request attempts, reported response usage and token-gate stops. Request precedes delivery; response usage is a provider report, not backend attestation. Failure usage is unknown; a request without a response may have consumed tokens. Missing/truncated evidence is not zero usage or proven budget compliance. No messages, paths, call IDs, tool arguments/results or exception text are stored here. Fingerprints cover normalized inputs only; see the separate configured profile for limits/provider identity. Optional call observations describe adapter HTTP timing and allowlisted response fields, not backend causes or token compliance. Missing observations stay unknown, including cancellation, parsing failures and unsupported providers. Wall/tool/iteration stops are not token-gate events. Not completion, acceptance, replay or permission to resume.

tool_progress.scope_note: Bounded prefix of observed tool-start/end metadata; arguments, results, error text, model messages and tool-call IDs are not stored here. Start precedes tool gates, so it does not prove dispatch or mutation. End/error presence is not patch acceptance or verification. A missing end may mean interrupted work or unsaved evidence; file changes may exist. This is not a transcript, checkpoint, replay, repair, or permission to resume. Unknown tool names are recorded as unknown_tool.
